decisions.quote: This study examines career planning programs and career services offices at colleges and universities in the United States as viewed by senior student affairs officers (SSAOs). Findings from a 1979 study of career services offices (CSOs) were compared to the current findings.

initial_expert_decision.quote: This study examines career planning programs and career services offices at colleges and universities in the United States as viewed by senior student affairs officers (SSAOs). Findings from a 1979 study of career services offices (CSOs) were compared to the current findings.
initial_expert_decision.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this work. The blind coder had access only to the four-line abstract of Vinson, Reardon, and Bertoch (2014) ('Career Services at Colleges and Universities: A 30-Year Replication Study'), which states that findings from a 1979 study of career services offices at colleges and universities were compared to the current findings without printing the full citation in the abstract. Shipped row input_row_index 382 (Reardon, Zunker, & Dyal 1979, 'The Status of Career Planning Programs and Career Centers in Colleges and Universities', DOI 10.1002/j.2164-585x.1979.tb00097.x, co-authored by Robert C. Reardon, who is also second author of the 2014 replication study) is the exact 1979 study described in target_index 0, so the target is already represented in the shipped dataset.
